note: Sapper's Path lands foundation (tools/land.js, tools/land-plan.js, tools/land-bake.js; tools/land-runbook.md): how a land's pictures become levels past 200. profile: the default difficulty profile; each land's land.json profile is merged over it (land-plan.js profileOf), so a later land asks for more without code. The grader's counts (grade, fast, the real pace's factor and thinking replays) are NOT here: land-bake.js takes them from tools/bake-config.json for main levels and tools/gallery-config.json bake for side quests, so tools/regrade.js and tools/freeze.js re-grade a banked land with 0 differences.

box.note: The max phone board (game-research/sappers-path-v4/pd-art-test/README.md: the 360x640 phone at 8 CSS px a cell): a picture of box cells inside the 1-cell frame (42 x 46 with it), many (8 or more colours, a 4-row yard) one row less; a landscape picture is capped by the width.

convert.note: tools/land.js convert: a painting under minColours colours at its chroma is converted again at each of chromaSteps in turn until it has them (the pd-art-test's rule); the most colours wins.

profile.note: The default land profile (tools/land-plan.js). tags: shares of Easy, Normal, Hard and Extreme; breathers, the fewest Easy levels per 50; run, the shortest and longest run of Hard and Extreme levels before a breather; end, the land's last tag. features: per deck feature its share of the land's levels and its amount (mystery: ? cards per level; hidden of: the share of the picture's eligible blocks hidden; linked pairs; lock: share of levels with a locked space, Extreme first then Hard, and key, the share of those that are key locks; moat, a board feature only for a land that lists it (organic moats, Land 2 on): share, ways [lo, hi], the openings as indexes into plan.moat.ways (gentlest first; the tag picks within the range, Extreme the top), and liquids, the water colours tried in turn (null: plain water; else a config.json board.pic.liquids name) when a picture colour sits too near the water). bands: the Normal random-tap win-rate band per tag; lookahead: the one-move-lookahead player's ceiling per tag; pace: each level's real-pace range and the aim (the land's median), ms. Raise a later land's profile in its land.json (more ?, more hidden, more links, more Hard and Extreme, lower bands).

plan.note: tools/land-bake.js, how a planned feature is built. lock: a key lock (a gilt key block dug in near the gate, gen.js lockKey) only when the gilt stands keyDE (CIEDE2000) from every picture colour, else it is built as a colour lock (the colour whose first squad comes nearest lockAt of the dealt order). hidden (hidePic): blobs over plain blocks that start out of reach, radii rx x ry cells, at least min hidden, no 4-connected group over maxGroup, each blob gap cells clear of every other (Land 1: so blobs never merge and get trimmed, and the share asked is the share hidden); never the ink or a masked picture's background. moat (organic moats, tools/moat.js; SPEC-v4 §9, the organic moats entry): ways, the opening sets by index (front: the ring nearest the entry; far: farthest from it; left, right); a level planned at index k tries k, k-1 ... 0 in turn over its candidates (a far or side opening can walk a sapper past the 15 s cap, measured), and the pick takes the planned set whenever it meets every target. The path: when the ring has a cut, the bank is open ground (as a castle's bank path), so once a cut is dug through the subject's whole outline opens; bank cells within edgeKeep of a way in where the subject meets the edge stay picture, and with no cut the whole bank does. The subject: the border-connected background taken off (a masked picture's bg, else each set of the top bgTop colours on the picture's outer ring with bgMin of it or more), its biggest 8-connected part and parts of partOf of it, closed by a disc of close cells, holes filled; kept by share - contactWeight x contact, within subject [lo, hi] of the picture and maxContact of its edge. The bank: grown by gap (a disc), at least one cell. The ring: width studs outside it; squeezed onto the edge where the bank meets it, stopping only where the subject does (an edge opening; two with merge or fewer edge cells between are one; maxEdge at most). A face is served by an opening within serve of its best cell, else cut there within open of one of the pick best cells, apart cells from any other, maxWays openings in all. Pockets of pond cells or fewer become water; at least minRing cells of water. waterDE [base, shade]: the water's colour at least this far (CIEDE2000) from every picture colour and shade, else the next liquid.

bake.note: Per level: candidates (perLevel, perLevelBy[tag]; --extra K adds K), each a deal under the dealing rules (deal + dealBy[tag], 5 spaces; squads of 20-50 on a board of deal.sizeRef cells (frame included), scaled with the board's cells, so a small landscape board deals smaller squads and a full portrait board bigger ones, near the pace aim inside the 55-tap cap; the outline's squads capped by capOf on masked pictures), linked pairs joined, tuned into the tag's band (the profile's bands; narrowFor tags also narrow the one-move-lookahead player to tune.narrow.stopAt) and graded on its tag. A pick meets every target: in band, real pace in the profile's range (aimWeight ms from its aim weigh as 1 point of rate), longest single tap maxWaitMs or less, maxTaps or fewer taps, the fast tapper not much better than patient play, the planned linked pairs, the lookahead at or under the profile's ceiling; else the least total miss (penalty), logged as a fallback. Side quests (the Wandering Gallery, no deck features) take sideBands in turn of sideCycle. dedupe: two picks this alike are near-duplicates. budget: threads (0: CPUs - 2) and the wall-clock cap.

map.note: tools/land.js map: a land's layout entries. Its 2 sheet templates (layout-shaped: file, road, level spots in road order, quest spots with branch, eggs, bridges as [road sample, kind]) are used in turn, A, B, then mirrored, A', B', then A, B again, until every level has a spot (at most maxSheets entries). Side quests go on a template's quest spot on the sheet holding their main level when one is free (the one nearest it along the road), else at a made spot questOff sheet px off the road beside the level, on the side with more room. eggCoins: each egg's coins, drawn in [lo, hi] from the land's seed (config.json map.eggCoins gets a row per new sheet). fade: new entries crossfade on the page (style.css .jr-sheet.fade), since a sheet's baked crossfade only fits the sheet it was painted over.

checks.note: tools/land.js check: the gates a land must pass before --install copies it into levels/, map/ and config.json (with the profile's own: tags, density, runs, pace). quests [lo, hi]: main levels between side quests; paceMedian [lo, hi]: the land's median real pace, ms.
